backswingLimit.source: Spec §5.2 (docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-18-p2b2b2c1-single-ball-design.md) and the user's account of the stance (2026-10-18)
backswingLimit.note: The shaft's greatest angle from vertical at the top of the backswing, 75°: where the shaft meets the groin. The head rises by ℓ·(1 − cos 75°) = 0.6178 m at it on the default mallet (ℓ = 0.833575 m). Bounds: 64°, the knee-height top, to 90°.

effortTorque.note: The isometric torque τ_0. τ_0 and ω_max solved jointly (design §4.4): the weakest swing preset, single-ball, reaches the ceiling 9 m/s (1.1 × the CA's A4D 8.18 m/s, design §4.3) at intensity 1 from its body-limited top (θ_max = 75.0°), and the drive's shaft there turns at κ·ω_max at contact, κ = 0.6667.

effortSpeed.note: The speed ω_max at which the player adds no more. τ_0 and ω_max solved jointly (design §4.4): the weakest swing preset, single-ball, reaches the ceiling 9 m/s (1.1 × the CA's A4D 8.18 m/s, design §4.3) at intensity 1 from its body-limited top (θ_max = 75.0°), and the drive's shaft there turns at κ·ω_max at contact, κ = 0.6667.

effortShare.note: κ = ⅔, the share of ω_max the drive's shaft uses at contact at full effort from its body-limited top, so the torque left at contact is a third of τ_0. A labelled placeholder (design §4.4); the gate sees ½ and ¾ beside it. Read only by scripts/fitStrokeShape.ts.

pendulumShare.note: Riches' roquet chapter has no still top hand: "The arms should swing freely from the shoulders so that the hands move FORWARDS throughout the swing". The default's top hand staying put is the design's choice, not a sourced figure.
